name: Transcript LOL - API Documentation
description:
The following documentation describes how to use the Transcript LOL REST API in your own workflows and AI agents (including Meta Muse connectors).

## Machine-readable spec

- OpenAPI 3.1 (this document): https://transcript.lol/openapi.yaml
- Alternate path (same file): https://transcript.lol/api/openapi.yaml
- Human docs: https://transcript.lol/docs

## Getting Started

To get started, you need to create an account and get an API key.
- Sign up for a free account at [Transcript LOL](https://transcript.lol/auth/register)
- Get an API key from [Integrations page](https://transcript.lol/dashboard/account/integrations)
- Send the key on every request as the `x-api-key` header (see `components.securitySchemes`)

## Muse / agent starter paths

Typical connector flow:
1. `GET /me` — verify the API key
2. `GET /spaces` — list workspaces (`spaceId`)
3. `GET /spaces/{spaceId}/recordings/search?q=…` — search transcripts
4. `GET /spaces/{spaceId}/recordings/{recordingId}/transcript` — read text
5. `POST /spaces/{spaceId}/recordings` with `sourceUrl` — transcribe a public URL
6. `GET|POST /spaces/{spaceId}/recordings/{recordingId}/insights` — read or generate insights

## Workspaces

Transcript LOL organises your content in workspaces. You can use different workspaces for different types of content. This gives the following benefits:
- Spending breakdown per workspace
- Setup custom prompts specific to each content type and get insights
- Isolation of content and settings per workspace 

Alternatively you can also choose to keep all your content under a single workspace.
